name: UpdateDepartment

parameters.help_en:
The custom department ID defined by the enterprise.
Ensure that this parameter value is unique
parameters.help_zh:
企业自定义部门 ID。
请确保该参数的唯一性
parameters.name: out_dept_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the parent department.
The parent department ID cannot be the same as the department ID.
Ensure that the parent department information has been maintained in Alibaba Business Travel
parameters.help_zh:
部门的父部门ID。
父部门 ID 不能与部门 ID 相同。
请确保父部门信息已经维护在阿里商旅
parameters.name: out_dept_pid

parameters.help_en:
The enterprise access token.
When calling the operation over HTTP, include this as a required parameter in the request URL. For information about how to obtain the token, refer to Enterprise access token (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985).
When appending the token, you can use any of the following formats: `so_corp_token=value`, `dtb_corp_token=value`, or `corp_token=value`. Recommended: `corp_token=value`
parameters.help_zh:
企业访问凭证。
使用 HTTP 方式调用接口时需要作为必填参数拼接在请求地址中。获取方式请参见：企业访问凭证 (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985)。
在拼接时，可以选择 `so_corp_token=value`、`dtb_corp_token=value` 以及 `corp_token=value` 任一写法，推荐使用 `corp_token=value`
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_corp_token
